_comment: Player-facing text for the online features (leaderboard, Sign in with Google, cloud save). Used by scripts/net/online.gd and score_entry.gd. %s and %d are filled in by the game.
offline: Online features are off in this build.
no_connection: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
not_set_up: The online server isn't set up yet.
server_error: The server had a problem (error %d). Try again later.
board_unreadable: The leaderboard sent something the game couldn't read.
board_bad_planet: There's no leaderboard for that planet.
score_need_name: Type a player name first (letters, numbers, spaces, - and _).
score_rate_limited: Too many scores sent. Wait a minute and try again.
score_accepted: Score sent. Your colony is #%d on the board.
score_not_top: Score sent, but it didn't make the top 100 for this planet.
score_duplicate: That score is already on the board.
sign_in_busy: Sign-in is already open in your browser.
sign_in_not_set_up: Sign in with Google isn't set up on the server yet.
sign_in_opened: Finish signing in with Google in your browser, then come back here.
sign_in_popup_blocked: Your browser blocked the sign-in window. Allow pop-ups for this page and press Sign in again.
sign_in_expired: Sign-in took too long. Press Sign in again.
signed_out: Signed out on this device. Your cloud save stays on the server.
cloud_need_sign_in: Sign in with Google first to use the cloud save.
cloud_too_soon: Saved a moment ago. Wait a few seconds and try again.
cloud_too_large: This save is too large for the cloud.
cloud_bad_account: Your sign-in is no longer valid. Sign out and sign in again.
cloud_unreadable: The cloud save couldn't be read.
